parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a canonical sample-app location. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where a participating record resides under Examples/ or SampleApp/ must be treated as a sample-app mirror and left alone. The duplicate 'DebugMetricsProvider.init' in the sample app is almost certainly a local convenience initializer written to bootstrap the debug HUD in the demo target, not a production type that should be unified with the one in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift'. Merging them would couple the production DebugPanel package to sample-app demonstration semantics, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
